title: Microsoft plans to retire its To Do app on June 30, 2027, offering migration to Planner for work and school accounts, but no replacement for personal accounts (Todd Bishop/GeekWire)
summary: Todd Bishop / GeekWire: Microsoft plans to retire its To Do app on June 30, 2027, offering migration to Planner for work and school accounts, but no replacement for personal accounts — Microsoft acquired the popular Wunderlist app in 2015, shut it down in 2020 and told its loyal
